scenario:
A nationwide Internet Service Provider (ISP) is implementing a comprehensive Package Management System to manage, track, and optimize their service offerings for residential, teleworking, and business customers. The system needs to handle multiple types of internet packages, each with specific download and upload speeds, data caps, and pricing structures, including promotional pricing and standard pricing after promotional periods.

The ISP aims to provide a wide array of packages catering to various customer needs, from basic residential packages to advanced business solutions. The system must efficiently manage package details, customer subscriptions, and billing information. It should also support dynamic pricing models and promotional campaigns to attract new customers and retain existing ones.

Additionally, the platform should include robust analytics and reporting tools to monitor package performance, customer usage patterns, and financial metrics. The ISP requires a detailed customer relationship management (CRM) system to provide personalized service, manage customer inquiries, and handle service upgrades or downgrades. Furthermore, the system should facilitate the integration of customer feedback to continuously improve service offerings.
